title: Trip On String
description: Gives a chance of tripping when stepping onto a tripwire block.
body: # Description Gives you a 1/4 chance to trip every time you step onto a tripwire block (placed string). Tripping causes 1 heart of fall damage and stops your movement for 1 second (slowness also gives fov change, which can help give the impression that you just fell on the ground if looking down) # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2. # Compatibility Incompatible with reused filenames or scoreboard name.
